content:
The **Helvetia Home** is a building within the Appalachian town of Helvetia.

Located in the southeastern part of, next to the crossroad of Pickens Road and Helvetia-Adolph Road, it is a two-story tall house. The first floor has a counter with a terminal on it, several broken display cases as well as a sitting area on the western side. On the southern side, some stairs lead up to the second floor.

The second floor has another sitting area, a kitchen on the eastern side, as well as a bedroom with a connected bathroom and a balcony to the north. The bedroom has several containers, including a Duffle Bag, a Wooden Crate and a Tool Case.

The Helvetia Home appears in *Fallout 76*.
